source: FEC.gov candidate and committee overview pages (www.fec.gov/data/candidate/<FEC id>/ and /data/committee/<id>/), 'Total raised' financial summary. OpenSecrets was blocked from this environment.
cycle: 2026 (FEC 2025-2026 two-year period for House members and senators whose seats are up in 2030; FEC page default election period for other senators, see each member's 'period')
notes: pac = FEC 'Other committee contributions' (contributions from PACs and other non-party political committees to the candidate's authorized committee(s)); pacShare = pac / total receipts. Total receipts also include transfers from joint fundraising committees, candidate loans and other receipts, so pac + individual + partyCommittees can be well below raised. The FEC candidate page default shows the full election period for senators: 2021-2026 for senators up in 2026 and 2023-2028 to date for senators up in 2028, so those totals are not directly comparable with two-year House figures. Coverage-through dates vary by member (latest report processed, mostly 06/30/2026 or 09/30/2026, some pre-election reports to 10/14/2026). Top industry is not provided by FEC pages and OpenSecrets (the source for industry data) was blocked, so topIndustry/topIndustryAmt are null for all members. Members running for Senate in 2026 use their Senate candidate page; four members' former campaign committees were converted to PACs and are flagged in 'note'. Not covered (2): A000383 Alan Armstrong, G000608 Darline Graham - appointed senators with no FEC candidate ID in the roster.
